independent_analytic_reasoning: On an sl2 block of dimension r, the neutral element has eigenvalues r-1,r-3,...,1-r, hence exp(pi i h) is the scalar(-1)^(r-1). Comparison with the principal element gives the stated good parities; in the GL/{+/-I} dual, equality modulo the scalar subgroup requires all row parities to agree. The metaplectic dual and genuine-representation restrictions remain separate.

The W2 natural character is2 atI,-2 at-I and0 on the other six matrices. Its self inner product is(4+4)/8=1, proving irreducibility directly. The induced character from eta has those same values, so the factor1/2 assertions do not rest on imported general branching or the initial script.

The typeD witness's J10 is real, symmetric, invertible and has signature(5,5). The volume norm is bilinear, not Hermitian: multiplying by i changes it by i^2=-1. These facts check every operative hypothesis rather than merely producing a formal determinant mismatch.

For an AR painting on the transpose, a column of original row length r must have an even bullet prefix and at most one c and one d. For even r its only options are all bullets or r-2 bullets followed by c,d; for odd r its options are r-1 bullets followed by c or d. Among m_r equal-height columns the prefix Young conditions choose a single cut, giving m_r+1 choices; adjacent unequal heights satisfy the prefix order automatically. This proves the product formula combinatorially. AH has only bullets and exists exactly for even row lengths.

For the C example(3,1,1), the default((1),(1)) shape has one all-bullet painting and three choices(r,c,d) opposite s, giving4. The shifted(column2,empty) shape has rr,rc,rd,cd in order, also4. The one primitive pair therefore gives the stated bounded combinatorial total8; irreducible representation cardinality still uses the source's representation-theoretic inputs.
